25548b02-1dca-44b0-a1a5-d97f63a69fbd.basic: Offside means a player is too far ahead when the ball is played. De Paul passed, but the move was ruled offside. (22 words)

545c2c84-018f-4570-a01c-753823feaeac.basic: A shot on goal means kicking the ball toward the net. A save means the goalkeeper stops it. Mac Allister shot and the goalkeeper saved it.

4ad26294-8aaf-4d69-83dd-bbf9ef797b32.basic: A shot is when a player kicks the ball trying to score. De Paul's shot was blocked. (16 words)
4ad26294-8aaf-4d69-83dd-bbf9ef797b32.intermediate: De Paul fired a shot for Argentina in the centre of the attacking third in minute 7, but it was blocked. Score 0-0. (24 words)
4ad26294-8aaf-4d69-83dd-bbf9ef797b32.tactical: De Paul's shot from the central attacking third was blocked at minute 7, with the game level at 0-0 in the 2022 final. (24 words)

2a0ff535-d44f-4838-a372-140631fb6184.intermediate: Tagliafico played a pass on the left side of the attacking third in the 13th minute, but it was ruled offside, with the score 0-0. (27 words)

6d527ebc-a948-4cd8-ac82-daced35bb715.tactical: Messi converted from the penalty spot in the 22nd minute, opening the scoring at 1-0 to Argentina in the 2022 final.

d49e9601-1cbf-4df7-9a77-16877abe49dc.basic: Offside means a player is ahead of the last defender when the ball is played. Messi was offside in France's half, so play stopped.
d49e9601-1cbf-4df7-9a77-16877abe49dc.intermediate: Messi was flagged offside in the attacking third on the right side in minute 29, with Argentina leading 1-0.
d49e9601-1cbf-4df7-9a77-16877abe49dc.tactical: Messi caught offside in the attacking final third, right channel, minute 29. Argentina 1-0 France.

f227a92e-d86c-4f3d-aa75-5ccb71adcae6.tactical: Mac Allister's effort from the left channel of the final third in the 31st minute, Argentina 1-0 up, was wayward.
